---
title: "Chord Library"
html-table-processing: none
---

::: {.column-screen}
```{=html}
<!-- The app lives at /apps/chord-library/index.html (standalone; also opens on its own). The frame grows to fit it. -->
<iframe id="chord-library-frame" src="/apps/chord-library/index.html" title="Chord Library"
  style="width:100%;border:0;display:block;min-height:900px"></iframe>
<script>
(function () {
  var f = document.getElementById('chord-library-frame');
  function fit() { try { f.style.height = f.contentDocument.documentElement.scrollHeight + 'px'; } catch (e) {} }
  f.addEventListener('load', function () {
    fit();
    try { new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(f.contentDocument.body); } catch (e) { setInterval(fit, 1000); }
  });
})();
</script>
```
:::
